name: collocation-entry
title: Collocation dictionary entry
description: A collocation-dictionary style entry for a word: its collocates grouped by part of speech (nouns, adjectives, verbs, adverbs), ranked by log-dice, using the corpus' own tagset mapped to coarse categories, plus a KWIC sample.

tag_map.description: Optional raw tag -> category overrides (see corpus_tagset).

args.where: CATEGORY in ['NOUN', 'PROPN', 'ADJ', 'VERB', 'ADV'] and not is_stopword(WORD) and ASSOCIATION >= ${params.min_logdice}

interpretation: Each row of 'entry' is a part of speech with its strongest collocates in log-dice order (up to 10; page 'lexical' for all, with LEFT/RIGHT counts showing position). The category of each collocate is its most frequent tag in the corpus, mapped to a coarse category - check corpus_tagset if categories look wrong and pass tag_map. Write the entry as in a collocation dictionary: ADJ + node, VERB + node, node + NOUN..., using LEFT/RIGHT to decide position and KWIC lines as examples. On untagged corpora every category is X and the entry is empty; use word-profile instead.
